title: Liquidation
description: One liquidation event on one venue. A DIRECT CONTRACT FOR data.liquidation (instrument_id, venue_id, at, side, price, quantity, value_usd, source, retrieved_at), which is append-only and carries a UNIQUE natural key (venue_id, instrument_id, at, side, price, quantity) precisely because REST liquidation feeds re-deliver recent events on every poll - the row is an event, never upserted, and the dedup key is what stops a re-delivery becoming a second liquidation. value_usd is null, never 0, when the notional cannot be computed: a 0 would read as a liquidated-nothing event.

at.description: When the liquidation happened, per the venue.

side.description: The side that was liquidated. Null when the venue does not report it - which is not the same as 'long'.

natural_key.description: venue_id, instrument_id, at, side, price, quantity - the dedup tuple data.liquidation enforces, because liquidation feeds re-deliver.
